claim: A recently opened project can be reopened from the Home surface after an application restart on desktop, and on Android through a persisted recent URI rebound with a fresh SAF picker grant.

verification.detail: Linux, macOS and Windows packaged journeys reopened a recent project after restart. Android verified real project selection, persisted recent URI, fresh-picker SAF rebind, read-grant/path validation and provider synchronization, plus multi-media import, captions, relink, export, process recovery and independently decoded VP9/Opus WebM.

limitations: Android evidence is from an emulator, not a physical device.

Attempt 1 failed with an Android provider freeze and a macOS launch timeout; both passed on the exact-SHA rerun. The failure causes are recorded in the history archive and were not independently diagnosed.
source: docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md, Recent project return - exact-SHA verified
